articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed, avg ~10.6/cycle (53 yesterday); third full day on the Opus 5.5 selector

experiment: There were no active experiments to evaluate. The pause gate expired today, so its field was dropped as its reason instructed. No new experiment was proposed, because the 2026-09-25 pipeline commits (03d76c38, c99f54b8, 1cd1cee5, a42ba727) changed sourcing, dedup, enrichment and state-media labelling at about 20:30 UTC. Only the 22:00 cycle ran on the new code, so any parameter change now would be confounded with them.
weakestArea: US datelines are furthest from target at 43% against a 25% cap, up from 34% yesterday. Americas datelines reached 28 of 53. Much of the rise comes from the Iran war and Trump–Xi stories, which carry Washington datelines (civilian toll, diesel export ban, USS Lincoln, Yemen strikes, Supreme Court voter rolls). The GAP_COUNTRIES Latin America expansion was already reverted, so the lever for this is not a source-location list.
watching: Iran's 7-day ceasefire proposal over Hormuz is running alongside US diesel export bans and Italy's diesel cap, so the oil shock is now producing policy responses in several countries.
Trump–Xi statements on Taiwan and Iran suggest the summit's trade pledges are being tied to security conditions.
Kazakhstan's Caspian exercise deaths led to detentions of officers, and there are now two separate stories on it, so it is worth watching for a same-event merge.
The DRC's Ebola toll reached 3,779 per Africa CDC, making it a sustained science and health story with a regional-spread risk.
Two appellate rulings (the DC Circuit on the Anthropic blacklist and the Sixth Circuit on Kalshi) are shaping US AI and prediction-market regulation at the same time.
coverageGaps: There were no Oceania datelines and only 4 from Asia, which makes this the fourth straight thin day for the Asia-Pacific.
Science fell to 6, just above the floor of 5, and three of those were space-launch stories, so primary-research science (Nature, Science, Cell) was nearly absent.
Africa had only 2 datelines, down from 8 yesterday, even though Sudan, the DRC and Nigeria (Ondo) stories ran.
context: The Opus 5.5 baseline (09-22→09-25) is complete. Multi-source reached 36%, clearing its 30% target for the first time under the new metric (28% yesterday), and the share of articles carrying an image URL rose from 9% to 30%. Both moves are probably effects of today's pipeline fixes and not the model. State-or-advocacy-only stories rose to 5 from 2 now that state sources are labelled rather than blocked. Wait until about 2026-09-28 for three days on the new pipeline code before proposing an experiment. The first candidate is the US dateline share, if it stays above 35%.
